Our Story

Where the Cloud
Forest Meets the Cup

Nestled in the mountains of San Salvador de Baru, Costa Rica — halfway between San Isidro de El General and the Pacific coast at Dominical — Oro de Diamante is a boutique, single-estate coffee positioned at altitude, surrounded by primary jungle, and driven by a single obsession: exceptional coffee.


With 4,000 Catuai plants growing across 2½ lush acres, we are small by design. Every cherry is hand-selected. Every decision traces back to quality. Some say the road ends here. For us, it is where everything begins. We are not a cooperative. We are not a commodity supplier. Every bean in every bag grows on this one estate: nothing is blended and nothing is bought in. That is what single source means to us.


Down by the creek we are designing Rancho Catarata, an open-air space made for yoga beside the water as it winds through the coffee fields.

MeetCarmenOwner of the Estate

Carmen is Costa Rican by nature, born and raised in San Carlos. Newly a citizen of the United States, she is bilingual by nature, at home in both Spanish and English, much like Oro de Diamante itself: grown in Costa Rica and roasted in the United States. She loves dogs, and she cherishes her blueberries, grown on her second estate in North Carolina.

The Coffee

Terroir You Can
Taste

Our elevation, volcanic soils, and the daily dance of Pacific mists and mountain sun create a microclimate ideal for slow cherry development — the hallmark of exceptional Arabica. First full harvest projected September 2027.

✦

Catuai at 1,650 Feet

One varietal, grown only on our estate. Mountain elevation delivers slower maturation, greater bean density, and layered flavor complexity.

✦

Hand-Harvested Cherries

Every cherry selected at peak ripeness. No strip-picking. No compromise on quality.

✦

Biodiversity-Rich Ecosystem

Shade trees, citrus, banana, and native flora — toucans visit our canopy.

✦

Completely Off the Grid

The estate runs entirely on solar energy and draws all of its water from a natural spring.

✦

Organically Grown

Grown using organic growing practices on our single-source estate. Certification is in progress.

✦

Full Traceability

A single-owner estate means complete chain-of-custody. Know exactly where your coffee grew.

Location & Provenance

Central Costa Rica,
Precisely Positioned
